sourceDiagnosis.concreteFriction: The optimizer workspace exposed evidence and editable files but did not provide one organized interface joining executable source entrypoints, normalized task inputs, observed data shapes, parameters, outputs and available checks. Earlier prompts also made bounded parameterized programs appear insufficient unless they replaced the whole skill.
sourceDiagnosis.supportingObservation: Attempt 8 generated a program only after the prompt explicitly stated that one successful evidence-backed run can justify a parameterized program/checker, that a bounded format need not replace the whole skill, and that direct inputs, outputs and checks should be used.
sourceDiagnosis.boundary: Attempt 6 remains a valid no-change. The diagnosis does not imply that every documentation-only result should have generated a program.

organizedFields: normalized task input locators and digests
observed JSON, CSV, YAML or text shapes

candidateBehaviorMatrix.result: returned without another optimizer or source run

candidateBehaviorMatrix.claimBoundary: This is not evidence of human-effort savings or future intervention probability.

sharedRuntimeDependencyCase.repairTrigger: A failed and the allowed repair changed rules.json
sharedRuntimeDependencyCase.expected: B's old passed observation is invalidated and B is reexecuted

v3ObservationInvalidation.dependencyMode: complete-static when bounded local reads are known; conservative revalidation otherwise

notApplicableCoverage: nested JSON instead of the supported flat CSV model
v5CapabilityBoundary.residualDuty: Unknown or unverified input conditions remain with the agent/original workflow and are not counted as automated success.
v5CapabilityBoundary.claimBoundary: These are deterministic synthetic capability cases, not independent real-skill successes or a real-input success rate.

runtimeAccounting.note: R4 used deterministic local fixtures. Developer-agent use remains separate from project runtime accounting.

claimBoundary: R4 proves bounded shared implementation-context generation, action realization checks, dependency-aware observation invalidation and explicit tested capability boundaries. It does not retroactively promote H8 documentation-only attempts, force valid no-change skills to generate programs, prove all declared inputs are supported, establish a real-skill success rate, or establish human savings, readiness or prospective reliability.
